daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different lately and people are noticing. Channel that focused Scorpio energy into one solid project instead of spreading yourself thin. Quality over everything.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about shedding what no longer serves you. Mercury's vibes are pushing you toward honest conversations and authentic connections. Trust your intuition—it's been hitting different lately, and for good reason.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy from afar. Either way, this week asks you to show up as your real self, not the edited version you think people want.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are sharp this week. Don't sleep on that idea brewing in your mind—it's worth exploring. Collaboration could unlock something unexpected. Your effort isn't going unnoticed, even if it feels quiet.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for rest mixed with movement. Listen to what actually energizes you instead of forcing routines that feel like punishment. Staying hydrated and touching grass will hit harder than usual.
